a Nasdaq notice on September 21, 2026, stating that it is not compliant due to delayed SEC filings.
The company has not yet filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, and remains delinquent on its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended April 30, 2026.
Netcapital has until October 23, 2026, to submit a compliance plan covering both overdue reports.
If Nasdaq accepts the plan, the company could receive up to 180 additional calendar days, through February 9, 2027, to regain compliance.
If Nasdaq rejects the plan, Netcapital may appeal the decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

title: Netcapital faces Nasdaq filing compliance issue
